notes: All 8 searches ran; none was refused. No news, debate, interview or questionnaire statement by Jessica Killin about AI was found. The only AI material is her campaign priorities page (https://www.killinforcolorado.com/priorities, section 'Restoring Fiscal Responsibility to Congress', read at source on 2026-11-14), which says: "This includes setting clear guidelines, standards, and rules of the road for the use of AI and emerging digital assets that establish long-term certainty and allow critical industries to grow, while also putting in place effective and fair oversight and protections for Colorado consumers and workers." It also says the United States must keep 'its worldwide lead in emerging technologies'. This is level D (promoting AI and light regulation; national security mentioned only generally). It is left out of 'statements' because the page shows no date; it links articles from May to September 2025, so it was probably written in 2025 or 2026. A Colorado Politics article of 1 November 2026 on Congress and AI was opened and does not mention her. As a former staffer and not a member of Congress she could not have sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; no House letter signed by her was found.
